title: Приложение работает!
body: На меня это точно действует. Бросил курить с первого дня установки приложения. Также заимел пару полезных привычек
author: Slavik_Krs

title: I Love it
body:
I Love the app, I’m using it for quite a LoNg time now, and I haven’t found anything better
All these statistics motivate me to work on myself and my streak pushes me to action
Motivational quotes, maybe lame, but sometimes are exactly what I need to go forward
I like options to categorize your habits, make it daily, weekly, whatever, make it yes/no or a number, calendar with habits nicely displayed 

The only thing I’d change is looks, app is wonderful and practical, but it lacks “sparkle” which is a cool minimalist design

title: Amazing- Best app ever
body:
I'm using it every day, at first I thought only about tracking my behavior - but after 2 weeks I've discovered that It's also motivating me, so great! Now I'm meditating every day, working on my projects, learning a new language (even if sometimes only for 5 minutes), WOW.
Polecam z całego serca, używam codziennie, najpierw tylko w celu śledzenia swojego zachowania, ale po 2 tygodniach zobaczyłam ze to mnie motywuje! Teraz medytuje codziennie, pracuje nad swoimi projektami, uczę się języka (nawet jeśli tylko 5 minut dziennie), WOW
